en-US.longDescription:
Deep Fathom Outpost is a lightweight, multi-cloud compliance CLI that collects
configuration and evidence from Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, AWS, Azure,
and GCP, evaluates it against policy, and projects findings into compliance
frameworks such as SOC 2, PCI-DSS, CMMC, HIPAA, FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, and CIS.
en-US.name: Deep Fathom Outpost CLI
